title: `httptest` for testing HTTP servers and clients

videos.script: An HTTP conversation has two sides, and this lesson tests each one with the standard library. {{recorder}} First the server side. The package gains a handler that answers with the most frequent words as JSON. The test calls it directly, with a recorder in place of the network. It finds a header set one line too late. {{server}} Then the client side. A source that fetches documents over HTTP needs somebody to talk to. The test starts a real server on the loopback, in a few milliseconds, and the client cannot tell it from any other. {{timeout}} Last, the server every client meets one day: the one that never answers. The test proves the client gives up when its deadline passes. And a handler that ignores the client holds the whole test open for six seconds. {{close}} Lesson 29 measures how fast all this counts words.
